intro: Travel: a ticket at the counter, a delayed train, a complaint to the carrier, a dream holiday. A classic exam topic — and very practical for life in Poland.
speaking.0.promptUa: Describe the illustration. Say where these people are, what they are doing and how they feel. Also say what you think will happen next.
speaking.0.phrases.0.ua: In the illustration I can see a railway station.
speaking.0.phrases.1.ua: Passengers are waiting on the platform.
speaking.0.phrases.2.ua: She is afraid she'll miss the train.
speaking.0.phrases.3.ua: The train will leave in a moment.
speaking.0.tips.0: **Spóźnić się na + accusative** (na pociąg) — a typical trap: not «do pociągu».
speaking.0.tips.1: Station vocabulary: **peron, tor, odjazd, przyjazd, opóźnienie** — weave it into your description.
speaking.0.tips.2: Prediction: «prawdopodobnie zdążą / nie zdążą» — a simple and effective «co dalej» option.
speaking.1.promptUa: Tell us about the holiday you would like to have. Say where you would go, with whom, what you would like to see and why this place is special for you.
speaking.1.phrases.0.ua: My dream holiday is a trip to…
speaking.1.phrases.2.ua: I would like to see… and try…
speaking.1.phrases.3.ua: This place is special for me because…
speaking.1.tips.0: **Tryb warunkowy** — the main tool of this topic: «pojechałabym, zobaczyłabym, zatrzymalibyśmy się».
speaking.1.tips.1: Specifics (Rzym, Florencja, pizza) make the dream real — a city's name counts for more than «piękne miejsce».
speaking.1.tips.2: Finish with an image: «wróciłabym pełna energii» — elegant and memorable.
speaking.2.promptUa: You are at a railway ticket office. You want to buy a train ticket to Kraków. Find out the times, price and discounts and choose the best connection.
speaking.2.phrases.0.ua: A ticket to Kraków for tomorrow morning, please.
speaking.2.phrases.2.ua: Which platform does the train leave from?
speaking.2.tips.0: **Poproszę + accusative** («poproszę bilet») — the most natural way to order at a ticket office, café or shop.
speaking.2.tips.1: **W jedną stronę / w obie strony** — one way / return. Give your choice at once so they don't have to ask twice.
speaking.2.tips.2: Discount → name your status («student», «senior») and the document: that keeps the conversation short and efficient.
writing.0.promptUa: You are on holiday. Write a short postcard to a friend: where you are, what the weather is like, what you are doing, and invite him on a joint trip next year.
writing.0.phrases.2.ua: Maybe we could go together next year?
writing.0.tips.0: A postcard = **greeting → where → weather → what I'm doing → invitation → closing**. Each element is a separate short sentence.
writing.0.tips.1: **Bardzo Ci się tu spodobałoby** — the conditional adds warmth and shows your level.
writing.1.promptUa: You bought a train ticket to Wrocław. The train was forty minutes late, and because of that you were late for an important meeting. Write a formal letter to the carrier: describe the situation, explain what problems it caused and ask for part of the ticket price back.
writing.1.phrases.0.ua: I'm writing about the delay of the train on the route…
writing.1.phrases.2.ua: I kindly ask for a refund of part of the ticket price.
writing.1.phrases.3.ua: I attach a copy of the ticket.
writing.1.tips.0: A complaint to the carrier: **journey details → what happened → consequences → what you want → attachment**.
writing.1.tips.1: **Zgodnie z zasadami przewoźnika** — referring to the rules makes the demand well-founded.
writing.1.tips.2: Add a contact for clarifications («chętnie udzielę informacji») — it sounds professional.
listening.0.intro: Listen to the announcement at the railway station.
grammar.0.intro: Transport, quantity and time — typical traps in the topic of travel.
grammar.0.questions.1.why: Means of transport — instrumental with no preposition: «pociągiem, autobusem, samolotem».
grammar.0.questions.2.why: Numbers 2–4 + nominative plural: «dwa bilety»; 5+ — genitive: «pięć biletów».
grammar.0.questions.3.why: A real condition in the future: «jeśli będzie opóźniony, zadzwonię».
grammar.0.questions.4.why: The duration we are going for: **na + accusative**: «na dwa tygodnie».
